_read_me: The sales page's one settings file (Brad 2026-10-17). News, the show switch, videos and collector quotes live HERE and nowhere else. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, East Coast time. A news item shows from its 'from' date to its 'until' date (both optional); 'ribbon' puts a short line in the bar across the top while it is current. Prices and the item count are NOT here: the page reads them from app/config.js (RR_PRICE_TEXT, RR_SHOW_PRICE_TEXT, BRAND_CATALOG_COUNT). show.ad is the York ad beside the logo: it shows from its 'from' to its 'until' date with town / where / days from here and both prices from config.js. The show dates must match the show dates in the backend's config tab (the app's welcome screen switches on those).

news.title: See us at York
news.text: We will be set up in Orange Hall at the York Train Fair this fall — Friday, October 23 and Saturday, October 24. Stop by for a live demo and the show-only price.
